why:      attempt 003 APPLIED ALL 53 MIGRATIONS SUCCESSFULLY and printed
          "Finished supabase db push". The step still went red because `yes`
          is killed by SIGPIPE once the CLI stops reading, and pipefail read
          that as the pipeline failing. The apply step now reads the CLI's own
          exit status, so a clean apply is reported as clean and a real
          failure is still caught.
